descriptions.text: With a stay at Huttons Hotel, Victoria London in London (London City Centre), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Westminster Abbey and Buckingham Palace.  This guesthouse is 0.5 mi (0.8 km) from Victoria Station Travel Information Centre and 1.2 mi (1.9 km) from Big Ben.

Make yourself at home in one of the 57 guestrooms. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers.
Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services.
